summary: Emergency Slots feature testing complete. All backend APIs and frontend UI verified. 15/15 backend tests passed. Admin can create/delete emergency slots, drivers can claim them, double-claim and exhausted slot claiming are properly rejected.

issues: React hydration warnings in console due to span elements inside table tr/td/th - cosmetic only, not affecting functionality (same as iteration_4)

admin_creates_emergency_slot.details: POST /api/schedules/emergency creates emergency slot with total_spots

driver_cannot_create_slot.details: Driver gets 403 when trying to create emergency slot

get_emergency_slots_for_week.details: GET /api/schedules/emergency?week_start=... returns all slots for the week

driver_claims_emergency_slot.details: POST /api/schedules/emergency/{id}/claim allows driver to claim a spot

claim_reduces_remaining_spots.details: Claiming reduces remaining_spots by 1 and adds driver to claimed_by

double_claim_returns_400.details: Same driver claiming twice returns 400 'Ai luat deja acest slot'

exhausted_slot_returns_400.details: Claiming with 0 remaining spots returns 400 'Nu mai sunt locuri disponibile'

driver_cannot_delete_slot.details: Driver gets 403 when trying to delete emergency slot

admin_cannot_claim_slot.details: Admin gets 403 when trying to claim emergency slot

claim_adds_to_driver_schedule.details: Claiming adds hour to driver schedule with added_by=emergency

admin_emergency_mode_toggle.details: Admin Program tab has emergency mode toggle button that activates emergency grid

admin_emergency_grid.details: Emergency mode shows grid with clickable cells for all hours/days

admin_emergency_dialog.details: Clicking cell opens dialog with +/- buttons to set spots count

admin_saved_slots_display.details: Saved emergency slots show as red cells with remaining/total count (e.g., 2/2)

driver_emergency_notification.details: Driver sees notification about available emergency slots

driver_emergency_cell_display.details: Available emergency slots show as red bordered cells with remaining count

driver_claim_dialog.details: Driver can click emergency cell and see claim dialog with remaining spots

driver_claim_success.details: Driver can claim slot and sees success message with updated remaining count

seed_data_creation: POST /api/seed resets all data including emergency_slots collection
context_for_next_testing_agent: Emergency slots feature fully implemented and tested. Backend: POST/GET/DELETE /api/schedules/emergency endpoints work correctly. POST /api/schedules/emergency/{id}/claim allows drivers to claim spots. Frontend: Admin has emergency mode toggle in Program tab, shows grid with clickable cells, dialog with +/- buttons. Driver sees emergency slots as red bordered cells, can click to claim via dialog. All 15 backend tests pass. All UI features verified via Playwright.
